title: Short Stuff: North Sentinel Island
summary: Short Stuff episode on North Sentinel Island, a small island in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands in the Bay of Bengal, home to the uncontacted Sentinelese. The hosts cover the island's location and population, the Sentinelese's way of life and hostility to outsiders (arrow volleys), early sightings in the 1700s, a prisoner who washed ashore after escaping a British penal colony, the 1967 Anthropological Survey of India expedition that left gifts like coconuts, iron rods and plastic utensils, the early-1990s peaceful contact that involved a woman and floated coconuts, India's law banning contact, the 2006 fishermen's deaths, and the 2018 killing of missionary John Allen Chau, who made repeated trips and was arrowed each time. The episode ends with the hosts saying outsiders should leave the island alone.

segments.title: Welcome and drone video prompt
segments.summary: Hosts open the show and introduce North Sentinel Island after a drone video of the island, noting its location in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands and the estimated uncontacted population.

segments.title: Sentinelese way of life and hostility
segments.summary: The hosts describe the Sentinelese as living like Neolithic hunter-gatherers, spearfishing and using dugout canoes, and say nearly every contact has been met with arrows or death.

segments.title: Early sightings and the prisoner's arrow death
segments.summary: Sightings date to the 1700s from European merchant ships. After a British penal colony was built nearby in the 1850s, a prisoner escaping on a raft washed up on the island and was found dead from arrows.

segments.title: 1967 Anthropological Survey of India expedition
segments.summary: A 1967 team of about twenty from the Anthropological Survey of India went ashore, found the residents hidden, and left gifts including coconuts, iron rods and plastic utensils.

segments.title: Off-topic banter about Quest for Fire
segments.summary: The hosts digress about the film Quest for Fire, Ron Perlman and Drive before returning to the topic.

segments.title: Early-1990s peaceful contact with coconuts
segments.summary: In the early 1990s a team including a woman made peaceful contact by floating coconuts from the boat; Sentinelese came into the water, examined the boat and interacted with people on the beach. India then passed a law banning contact.

segments.title: 2006 fishermen deaths and John Allen Chau's killing
segments.summary: Fishermen from Myanmar were killed in 2006 after an emergency landing and buried on the island. In 2018 missionary John Allen Chau was killed by arrows after several trips, including one where he brought a fish and a waterproof Bible was struck by an arrow.

segments.title: Remains and closing reflections
segments.summary: The hosts note that the bodies of Chau and the fishermen remain on the island, discuss how Chau is viewed differently by different groups, and conclude that outsiders should heed the warnings and leave the Sentinelese alone.

segments.title: Sign-off
segments.summary: Hosts sign off the Short Stuff episode with the standard production credit.
